Home.faq1q: How do I know a part fits my truck?
Home.faq1a: Every part lists the truck makes, models and years it fits. Use Find My Part to see only parts for your truck — or send us your truck's details on WhatsApp and we'll check before you buy.
Home.faq2q: What do New, Used and Reconditioned mean?
Home.faq2a: New parts have never been fitted. Used parts come from another truck and are sold as they are, with condition notes when something matters. Reconditioned parts were used, then repaired or rebuilt to working order.
Home.faq3q: Can you find a part that isn't listed?
Home.faq3a: Often, yes. Not everything we can get is online. Send a part request with your phone number, or a photo on WhatsApp, and we'll tell you if we can get it and at what price.
Home.faq4q: How do I pay and collect my order?
Home.faq4a: Order online and pay in cash when you pick it up. We confirm availability and pickup details with you by phone or WhatsApp. Prices are in FCFA.
Home.faq5a: No account is needed to browse, search or request a part. You only need one to place an order, so you can track it.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy & Cookies
PrivacyPage.intro: TruckParts is a single-vendor store for truck spare parts. This page explains what information we collect, how we use it, and what cookies this site sets.
PrivacyPage.dataBody: When you create an account or place an order, we collect your name, email address, phone number and pickup/shipping address. When you request a part, we collect the name and phone number you give us (and your email, if you add it) so we can contact you about it. Passwords are never stored in plain text.
PrivacyPage.useBody: Your information is used to create your account, process and fulfil orders, answer part requests (by phone or WhatsApp), send order-status emails and provide customer support. We don't sell your personal data.
PrivacyPage.paymentsBody: You can pay in cash when you collect your order. If you pay online, payment happens on our payment provider's own secure page — we never see or store your card or mobile money details.
PrivacyPage.cookiesIntro: We don't use advertising or tracking cookies. The only cookies this site sets are:
PrivacyPage.cookieSession: Session cookie — keeps you signed in. Required for the site to work.
PrivacyPage.cookieCsrf: Security cookie (CSRF) — protects your account from cross-site request forgery. Required for the site to work.
PrivacyPage.cookieLocale: Language preference — remembers whether you're viewing the site in English or French.
PrivacyPage.sharingBody: We share order details with our payment provider only when you pay online, with our email provider only to send you messages about your order, and with our hosting, analytics and error-monitoring providers only as needed to run the site. We don't share your data for marketing.
PrivacyPage.rightsBody: You can ask us to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time by contacting us below.
PrivacyPage.contactBody: Questions about this page or your data — reach us at {email}.
PrivacyPage.metaDescription: What information TruckParts collects, why, and what cookies the site uses.
PrivacyPage.analyticsBody: We count visits, searches and clicks with Umami, a privacy-friendly analytics tool that uses no cookies and doesn't identify you. It tells us things like which parts people look for, so we can stock them. We also keep anonymous daily totals ourselves — which search terms found nothing and how many times each WhatsApp button was used — with no IP address or account attached.
PrivacyPage.errorsBody: If something breaks, technical details about the error (the page, the browser, what went wrong) are sent to our error-monitoring service, Sentry, so we can fix it. We don't include your passwords or payment details.

About.metaDescription: Who TruckParts is and how buying a truck part here works.
About.title: A straightforward way to find truck parts that actually fit.
About.subtitle: We list new, used and reconditioned parts with honest condition notes and vehicle compatibility up front, so you know what you're getting before you come by.
About.howBody: Every listing shows its condition (new, used or reconditioned), part number, and which makes and models it fits — no guessing from a blurry photo. Use Find My Part to filter the catalogue down to your exact truck, or browse everything directly.
About.pickupBody: We're a single-location business — parts are viewed and picked up in person rather than shipped. Once your order is placed, we contact you to confirm availability and arrange pickup.
About.gradingBody: Not every part needs to be new to work well. Grading parts honestly as new, used or reconditioned — with notes when something matters — means you can choose based on what your truck actually needs.
About.ctaBody: Search by your truck's make, model and engine — or just ask us.

AdminImport.title: Import products
AdminImport.intro: Add or update many products at once from a spreadsheet. You'll see exactly what will happen before anything is saved, and the import is all-or-nothing: if any row has a problem, nothing changes.
AdminImport.step1Download: Download the template and open it in Excel (or Google Sheets / LibreOffice).
AdminImport.step1Fill: Keep the first line (column titles), replace the example rows with your parts.
AdminImport.step1Save: Save as CSV (File > Save as > CSV). Any CSV option works, including French Excel's default.
